title: Privacy Disclosure, SDK, and Vendor Semantics
authorityBoundary: This artefact defines semantic requirements for Apple privacy nutrition labels, Apple privacy manifests and required reason APIs, Google Play Data Safety, Android permission disclosure, third-party SDK data practices, and vendor or subprocessor registries. It does not create App Store submission, Play Console submission, privacy policy publication, legal conclusions, SDK installation, provider credential setup, vendor onboarding, procurement approval, privacy compliance, store readiness, production readiness, live-provider readiness, or human acceptance.

applePrivacyNutritionLabelMapping.rule: Apple privacy nutrition label inputs must be derived from USF data inventory, tracking posture, linked-data posture, purposes, SDK data practices, validators, proof, and non-claims.
mustReject: privacy label value without data inventory mapping
tracking value without consent and tracking posture mapping
linked-data value without semantic backing
SDK-derived label without SDK data practice mapping

applePrivacyManifestAndRequiredReasonMap.rule: Apple privacy manifest and required reason API metadata must map app and third-party SDK usage to USF semantics before any store or compliance claim.
mustReject: required reason API without declared semantic reason
privacy manifest entry without data inventory mapping
third-party SDK manifest without SDK data practice mapping
manifest readiness claim without proof and owner acceptance

googlePlayDataSafetyMapping.rule: Google Play Data Safety answers must be derived from USF data inventory, collection, sharing, security practice, deletion, purpose, SDK data practice, validator, proof, and non-claim mappings.
mustReject: Data Safety answer without data inventory mapping
sharing answer without vendor or SDK mapping
deletion answer without deletion semantics
security practice answer without semantic backing

androidPermissionDisclosureMapping.rule: Android permissions and Play policy disclosures must map to USF capability authority, runtime disclosure, privacy data categories, validators, proof, and non-claims.
mustReject: Android permission without capability mapping
runtime disclosure without privacy data category mapping
Play policy disclosure without semantic backing
permission readiness claim without proof

thirdPartySdkDataPracticeRegistry.rule: Third-party SDK usage must have a data practice registry entry before app-surface use, disclosure, approval, or readiness claims.
mustReject: SDK use without registry entry
SDK data collection without privacy category mapping
SDK sharing without vendor mapping
SDK approval claim without approval gate and proof

vendorAndSubprocessorRegistry.rule: Vendor, subprocessor, ads, analytics, hosting, SDK, or provider use must have registry mappings for region, data category, purpose, contract posture, privacy links, validators, proof, and non-claims.
mustReject: provider use without vendor mapping
SDK use without vendor or subprocessor mapping
ads or analytics use without vendor mapping
vendor approval claim without proof and owner acceptance

validatorRequirements.description: Reject Apple privacy nutrition label values that diverge from USF data inventory, tracking, linked data, purpose, SDK data practice, and proof mappings.
Reject privacy manifest or required reason API metadata that does not map to USF capability, data inventory, SDK data practice, privacy category, and proof mappings.
Reject Google Play Data Safety answers that diverge from USF data inventory, collection, sharing, security practice, deletion, purpose, SDK data practice, and proof mappings.
Reject Android permissions, runtime disclosures, or Play policy disclosures without USF capability, privacy data category, purpose, and proof mappings.
Reject app-surface SDK use without SDK data practice registry, privacy, consent, vendor, approval gate, and proof mappings.
Reject provider, SDK, ads, analytics, hosting, or vendor use without vendor or subprocessor registry mapping and proof.

proofRequirements.description: Future proof must demonstrate that store privacy disclosures, privacy manifests, Data Safety answers, Android permission disclosures, SDK registry entries, and vendor registry entries are semantically mapped and fail closed when mismatched.

implementationEvaluationRequirements: data inventory mappings exist for relevant app surfaces
SDK and vendor registry mappings exist where applicable
store privacy disclosure mappings exist for Apple and Google surfaces
validator requirements are implemented and selftested
planted-defect fixtures exist for mismatched privacy labels, manifests, Data Safety, permissions, SDKs, and vendors
proof evidence exists for mapped and rejected cases
owner acceptance is recorded before any privacy compliance, store readiness, vendor approval, SDK approval, or submission claim
